artworks.title: Das Bretspiel (Ladies and Gentlemen Playing Board Games)
artworks.medium: engraving with etching on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of individuals engaged in playing cards at an ornately decorated table. The room is elegantly furnished and features intricate designs and floral motifs.

artworks.title: Das Billardspielen (Billiard Players)
artworks.medium: engraving with etching on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group playing billiards in a decorated room. The scene includes a large billiards table, individuals playing or watching, large windows with light coming through, intricate details framing the scene, and framed art on the walls.

artworks.title: A Magnificent Stag in a Landscape
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a stag standing in a natural setting. The drawing shows a stag with large antlers in a landscape with trees and foliage. In the background, there is a hill or mountain, with a sky detailed with clouds. The drawing captures the details of the stag's fur and the natural surroundings realistically.

artworks.title: A Wooded Lakeside with an Italianate Villa
artworks.medium: gouache on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a low horizon, featuring a mountain and a castle surrounded by greenery. Trees, including a cow, some goats, and a figure, are depicted in rich, detailed brushstrokes against a sky painted with pastel tones and earthy hues.

artworks.title: The Virgin and Child with Saint  Anne and Saint John
artworks.artist: Schelte Adams Bolswert, after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features four figures in an architectural setting. On the left, an older woman stands, holding the shoulders of a young child who is leaning towards a baby sitting on the lap of another woman. The baby reaches towards a lamb lying beside them. The seated woman has dark hair covered with a draped fabric, wearing a flowing garment. The older woman wears a robe and head covering. The young child is barefoot, and they are surrounded by stone columns under a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Jesus Christ Appearing to Saint Roch
artworks.artist: Paulus Pontius, after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a group of figures in a classical style art. The central figure on the upper level is a man standing with arms raised, looking upwards while an angelic figure gestures towards him. The man's hair is curly and he has a beard. He wears a loose cloth draped around him, partially covering his body. Next to him, a divine figure with radiant light behind him extends an arm toward the man. To the left is a cherub-like figure holding a scroll. Below them, there is a scene with multiple figures in various poses of distress or prayer. A man on the left is kneeling, with another figure beside him reaching upwards, an elderly man at the center is also extending his arms upwards. To the right, a man and a woman are seated on the ground, with the man looking upwards and the woman leaning on him with a gaze directed at the central figures above. The figures are partially draped in cloth, their expressions adding to the dramatic composition. The background features arch-like structures which provide a sense of depth to the scene. At the top of the image, there is a dog that appears to be resting next to a walking stick and a hat. The setting appears to be both outdoors, given the presence of clouds and sky, and within a structured environment, with the architectural elements framing the scene.

artworks.title: Saint Rosalia Crowned by the Child Jesus
artworks.artist: Paulus Pontius, after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows several individuals in various poses, most of their bodies visible. A standing woman on the right holds a child, while the child reaches towards a kneeling figure on the left. To the right of the kneeling figure, another person with aged features and a full beard stands, holding a staff. Flanking these central figures are additional individuals. Two cherubic figures hover in the air above, amidst swirling clouds, each holding small branches. The background is architectural, with large stone pillars and steps ascending into a seemingly divine structure. Books and ornamental objects lie on the steps.

artworks.title: The Consecration of a Bishop
artworks.artist: Pieter Claesz Soutman, after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This image depicts a religious ceremony. In the scene, a group of figures surrounds a central figure seated on a throne. The central figure appears dignified and authoritative, receiving an act that seems to be a consecration or crowning ceremony from two bishops holding a mitre above their head. The figures are wearing detailed ecclesiastical attire, pointing to the ceremony's significance. The background features grand architectural elements and a crowd of spectators. Overhead, a dove emits rays of light, suggesting a divine presence or blessing. The drawing's texture and detail emphasize the grand and solemn nature of this ecclesiastical event.

artworks.title: Rubens and van Dyck, a Double Portrait
artworks.artist: Paulus Pontius, after Sir Anthony van Dyck and Erasmus Quellinus II
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper

artworks.title: Isabella Clara Eugenia, Infanta of Spain
artworks.artist: Paulus Pontius, after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a three-quarter view portrait of a person, approximately from the waist up. The person is standing and facing the viewer directly. They have a solemn expression with arched eyebrows and their eyes appear to be gazing directly at the viewer. The individual's hair is covered under a veil that is part of their attire. The person wears dark, flowing robes with a white undershirt, and their hands are held together in front of their body, partially covered by the robe's sleeves. Surrounding the portrait is an elaborate frame with decorative elements, including a pair of cherubs holding a billowing drapery at the top. The cherubs have wings and one holds a laurel wreath around an eye within a triangle. The background is ornately detailed with patterns and Latin inscriptions in the frame.

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Magi
artworks.artist: Lucas Emil Vorsterman, after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper

artworks.title: A Backstreet in London
artworks.medium: graphite with stumping on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift in Memory of Philip Leonard
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of an alleyway viewed from a slightly elevated angle. The scene shows buildings lining the narrow path, drawing the eye upwards. In the foreground, there is a group of figures and a solitary figure walking away. The pencil work is soft and sketchy, with varying intensities of graphite creating light and shadow. The composition is in shades of gray, with a monochromatic color palette emphasizing light and shadow. The background is indistinct, blending buildings and figures into a hazy suggestion of architecture and life.

artworks.title: Crucifixion
artworks.medium: hand-colored woodcut on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a crucifixion scene with surrounding figures. The artwork depicts a central figure on a wooden cross, with two figures standing on either side. The figure on the cross is portrayed with head inclined to one side and arms outstretched. The cross stands on a rocky ground, with a skull at its base. To the left, a cloaked figure in a draped blue garment appears in a solemn posture, while a figure on the right is dressed in earth-toned robes. The background consists of serene sky-blue and lighter tones. The use of bold outlines and delicate shading gives a sense of texture and form.

artworks.title: Christ on the Cross with the Virgin and Saint John
artworks.medium: color woodcut, printed in black, red, blue, brown, olive, and yellow on vellum, and hand-colored in blue, pinkish beige, and some touches of red on vellum
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Lt. Col. and Mrs. William K. Konze
artworks.description: This is a painting of a religious scene depicting the crucifixion. The central figure is a man on a cross with a halo, and the cross is set against a blue sky. Flanking the man on the cross are two haloed figures, one on each side, wearing distinct flowing garments. The one on the left is dressed in blue, and the one on the right is in red and green. The ground is covered with green vegetation, and a skull is depicted at the base of the cross. The composition is bordered with a decorative frame and contains Latin text at the bottom.

artworks.title: Philip Melanchthon
artworks.medium: woodcut on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a fur-collared robe with crossed arms. He has a lined face, curly sparse hair, plain shoes, and a serpent emblem beside him. The background is plain with the number "1561" and a small symbol.

artworks.title: French Troops before Salins and the Surrounding Hills
artworks.medium: red chalk over black chalk surrounding red chalk counterproof, on two joined sheets of laid paper, incised overall for transfer and laid down
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with travelers and people in a countryside. In the background, there are hills or mountains with a small town visible. The painting style is intricate with detailed brushstrokes, creating a sketch-like appearance. The color palette consists of warm tones, primarily in the terracotta or red ochre spectrum. The foreground features mounted figures and caravans, leading the eye towards the distant hills and town. Trees and vegetation add texture to the scene.

artworks.title: The State Opening of Parliament in the Rebuilt House of Lords
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache over graphite on heavy wove paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a grand hall with intricate decorations. The painting depicts a vast interior space characterized by high, ornate ceilings featuring a pattern with gold and blue elements and walls lined with large stained-glass windows that allow light to filter into the room, casting colorful reflections on the surfaces. The architecture is elaborate, with intricately carved wooden panels and ornamental details throughout. The far end of the hall displays a raised platform adorned with sculptures and paintings. The colors used are warm tones of gold, brown, and red, giving a luxurious feel to the space.

artworks.title: Two Chinoiseries
artworks.medium: brush and black ink with graphite and incised framing line
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate garden scene. The drawing features a garden setting within a circular outline. The garden includes architectural elements such as a decorative pavilion or gazebo, surrounded by plants and foliage. A bird is flying above, and elegantly dressed figures are in the foreground. The drawing showcases fine lines and a soft rendering of the subjects.

artworks.title: Marsh Landscape at Twilight
artworks.medium: transparent and opaque watercolor,  pastel, graphite, and scraping on rough, light brown wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape view from a low eye level of an expansive field. The horizon is located in the lower third, separating hills and trees from the sky. Several tall, slender trees are to the left with bare branches reaching upwards. The sky has soft brushstrokes blending shades of blue, pink, and orange. The ground has earthy tones with light reflecting off small puddles. The color palette consists of muted earth tones contrasting with warmer sky hues.

artworks.title: The Return of the Spies from the Promised Land
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black chalk on laid paper, laid down on an old album sheet
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures carrying a large cluster of grapes on a pole. The drawing depicts a scene where multiple figures are engaged in carrying or observing a large cluster of grapes suspended on a pole. The figures are sketched in a loose, dynamic style with ink washes that convey movement and energy. The central figures appear to be actively engaged in transporting the grapes, while other figures look on. The use of brown ink and wash gives the drawing an aged appearance. The lines are fluid and expressive, capturing the movement of figures in an impressionistic manner.

artworks.title: A Windmill and Cottages on a River Bank, Men in Rowing Boats
artworks.medium: black chalk with pinkish-gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a rural landscape with a windmill as the central focus, surrounded by structures, trees, and figures engaged in various activities. The scene is depicted in a monochromatic palette with gentle pencil or charcoal tones, creating a soft and timeless quality. Fine details are visible in the architecture and natural elements, and birds are scattered in the sky.

artworks.title: Rinaldo is Welcomed by the Monks
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown and gray wash over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The sketch depicts several figures engaged in conversation. The central figure, wearing a crown and a robe, is seated to the left, facing others. Other figures, also wearing robes, are gathered around. The setting includes arches and ornate vaulted ceilings. The sketch has a soft, unfinished quality with light shading and faint linework, and the paper grain texture is visible in the background.

artworks.title: Olympia Tells Roland Her Sad Story
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two seated figures with a table between them. The scene includes one figure on the left wearing armor, gesturing upwards, while the figure on the right holds an arm raised and wears a dress and a crown or headdress. Light, wispy lines above suggest ghostly or celestial figures hovering above them. The composition is delicately sketched in soft pencil lines, capturing the folds of fabric and the contours of the figures with light shading. The drawing conveys a narrative or interaction between the two central figures, engaged in a conversation or an exchange of significance.

artworks.title: A Rocky Wooded Landscape with a Figure by a Stream
artworks.medium: black and gray wash with pen and black ink on tan laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a small figure standing among trees. The horizon is not clearly defined but is indicated by a line of trees. The artwork is monochrome, likely using ink or watercolor with expressive brushstrokes creating a textured effect. The foreground has darker, dense foliage while the background has lighter, softer colors resembling clouds. The color palette consists of black, gray, and white tones.
